analysis.headline: Sells Your Data to Partners
analysis.quote: We may disclose personal information to third parties or process your personal information for various purposes, including targeted advertising. These kinds of disclosures may be deemed selling under certain state privacy laws. You have the right to opt-out of the sale or processing of your Personal Information for targeted advertising as described above.

analysis.headline: Shares for Partner Marketing
analysis.quote: Vendors for Business Operations that receive data to provide services to a Walmart entity (such as advertising networks, marketplace sellers, analytics providers, etc.). Business partners, including those that receive data for their own independent use and not to provide services to a Walmart entity.

analysis.headline: Trains AI on Your Data
analysis.quote: Undertaking activities to verify or maintain the quality or safety of our services or devices and to improve, upgrade, or enhance them, such as training our AI.

analysis.headline: Collects Your Biometric Data
analysis.quote: Biometric Information, such as voice prints, imagery of the iris or retina, face geometry, and palm prints or fingerprints.

analysis.headline: Tracks Your Precise Location
analysis.quote: Also, depending on your device’s settings and with your consent, we may collect precise geolocation information.

analysis.headline: Cameras, ALPRs Track You
analysis.quote: For example, our point-of-sale terminals process your credit card information when you complete your purchase, and we operate cameras and automated technologies in-store and on Walmart property outside of our store for security and operational purposes. Automated License Plate Readers (ALPR) may also be in use on our properties, where permitted by law.

analysis.headline: Gets Your Data from Others
analysis.quote: We may obtain personal information about you from other sources to help us correct or supplement our records, improve the quality or personalization of our services, increase the appeal and relevance of advertising, and to prevent or detect fraud.

analysis.headline: Shares Data Across Affiliates
analysis.quote: We may disclose your personal information with other retail and non-retail companies (e.g., Sam’s Club and One Finance) within our corporate family for them to use in ways that are consistent with this Privacy Notice.

analysis.headline: Infers Your Preferences
analysis.quote: Inferences, such as individual preferences and characteristics. This may include inferences drawn from and related to shopping patterns and behaviors, intelligence, and aptitudes.

analysis.headline: Combines VIZIO Data with Yours
analysis.quote: You also have a choice whether to link and combine the Viewing Data, Activity Data, Mobile App Data, and Mobile Streaming Data (“VIZIO OS Data”) from your VIZIO OS products with your Walmart account information, which can be turned on or off at any time by logging into VIZIO.com/account with your Walmart account.
